series.title: October Road
series.description: Successful novelist Nick Garrett returns to Knights Ridge, Massachusetts, ten years after abandoning the family and friends he later fictionalized in a bestselling book. His attempt to reconnect with the town reopens old resentments and his unresolved relationship with Hannah, whose son Sam may connect Nick to the life he left behind more deeply than he expects.
series.collectionScope: Two broadcast seasons plus the DVD-exclusive series epilogue retained as S02E14.
